title: feat(wire): closing overlap, centre-line slit and open-run skims for Wire Contour
body:
feat(wire): closing overlap, centre-line slit and open-run skims for Wire Contour

Wire Contour gains the three polish cuts of #3216. Each is stated, never
inferred, and refused by name where it has nothing to state.

What changed

- Closing overlap (closed profiles). `WireContourOp.overlap` and
  `WireParams.overlap` (mm, default 0) ride the cut past the seam by the
  stated arc length before the lead-out returns to the threading point,
  so the start of the cut is burnt over and no witness mark is left.
  The past-seam extension walks the ring from the seam point and cuts
  the last point to the exact remainder; the kerf law judges the return
  move like every other. Refused: with tabs (tabs pin the seam), on an
  open run (no seam), at a negative or non-finite length. A skim
  inherits the overlap. The note says the ride.
- Centre-line slit (open runs). New `WireSide::Centre`: the wire rides
  the run itself, the kerf burns both sides, no side is kept - so the
  kerf law has no product to protect and is not applied, while the
  corner/doubling-back law and the run-out laws still refuse what the
  wire cannot follow. The note says "no side kept".
- Skims on open runs. `check_passes` no longer refuses an open run; the
  offset-ordering laws judge it like a closed profile. `wire_passes`
  routes each open-side skim through the open-run generator: every pass
  re-enters from the air at the run's start end, at its own run-in
  point, walked in the run's own direction - a reversed pass on an open
  run is refused by name (one pinned semantic), and no move joins one
  pass's run-out to the next pass's run-in (the wire is threaded anew).
- Wire verify (sim). `CutSide::Centre` is judged as an open run whose
  kerf law is skipped by statement (`CENTRE_SKIP` on the report line);
  the ends' clearance is still judged. Skims on an open run are
  generated but named as not verified here yet (the verify reads one
  open pass) - a follow-up can extend the open law to per-pass kerfs.
- App, file and UI. The overlap rides the seed, the command door's
  sanity, the op stamp (only when stated, so no existing stamp moves)
  and the project DTO (`overlap`, absent reads 0); `side` reads and
  writes `centre`. The wire page gains the Closing overlap row and the
  Centre choice; its test count grows by one.

Pinning tests

- `the_closing_overlap_rides_past_the_seam_and_is_refused_without_a_seam`
  (camcraft_motion::wire_edm): ride length past the seam, inherited
  skim ride, lead-out home, and each refusal by name.
- `a_centre_slit_rides_the_run_itself_and_takes_skims_from_the_air`
  (camcraft_motion::wire_edm): centre ride on the line, air threading
  per pass at its own offset, reversed refused.
- `skim_laws_refuse_by_name`: the open-run skim refusal is replaced by
  the offset laws accepting it.
- `wire_closing_overlap_and_centre_side_apply_and_undo` (camcraft-ui).

Readings: the overlap ride of 1.0 mm on a 40x20 die ends at
(1.000, -9.835) with K = 0.165; a centre slit's left skim threads at
(60.000, -1.145) against the rough's (60.000, -1.165).

Not exercised

- The Sodick post refuses an open run's skims by name at its rapid
  guard: its manual states no such pass structure, and the generic ISO
  post is the one that cuts, travels and threads anew around each
  boundary.

Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`, 665 steps)

- All sim, motion, app and ui suites green, the three pinning tests
  included.
- Three steps are red, each not caused by this change:
  - `app suites: docs_troubleshooting` - the stem of a clearance
    message spans a line-continued string in `crates/sim/src/verify`;
    no file of this change is in its sources.
  - `app suites: example_catalog` (2d/drill-overfeed) - the fixture
    `refusal.txt` on disk reads CRLF against the generated LF; a
    checkout line-ending state, no fixture touched here.
  - `ui suites: lib` - a native STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION at 20 test
    threads after all tests printed ok; it re-runs green in full
    (`1431 passed; 0 failed`) and at 1 and 4 threads. A teardown race
    of the headless window harness on this machine, not this change.

Screenshots (images only on the fork's pr-screenshots branch)

- Controls, before: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FlamingFireCoding/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/pr3617-wire-controls-before.png
- Controls, after (the new Closing overlap row and its help): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FlamingFireCoding/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/pr3617-wire-controls-after.png
- Full window, before: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FlamingFireCoding/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/pr3617-wire-window-before.png
- Full window, after: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FlamingFireCoding/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/pr3617-wire-window-after.png

Rework after the safety review (head 795d69e95)

The eight review items of 2026-11-25 are addressed on the same branch:

1. The Centre slit's run-out clearance joins the generation stamp
   (cutting.rs), so an edited or re-stated clearance reads Stale -
   pinned through the edit command and a project reload (wire_stamp).
2. The overlap's ride includes the seam edge's own remainder back to
   the seam: a 100 mm overlap covers exactly 100 mm of arc, forward
   and reversed, and a ride longer than one full lap is refused by
   name (motion tests, both directions, near the perimeter).
3. An open run's skim passes are rethreaded in the air: a travel move
   (a rapid, no wire through it) marks each pass boundary, the wire
   verify judges each pass at its own kerf and its own ends, and the
   generic ISO post cuts, travels and threads anew around it - a new
   app test generates, verifies AND posts an open run with a skim
   (new golden wire_contour_open_skims.nc).
4. A stated overlap beside a no-core burnout is refused by name at the
   command door (create and edit tested).
5. A stated overlap on a 4-axis cut and beside a constant taper is
   refused by name at the command door (the 3-degree/1 mm case that
   once failed with "repeats a point" now refuses at the door;
   create and edit tested per combination).
6. The three-file merge with current main keeps both sides; the
   resolved tree builds and its gates run (below).
7. Before / after screenshots of the changed Wire Contour controls
   are on the fork's pr-screenshots branch and linked below.
8. This PR edits .claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md; the body
   carries the process line. PROCESS_VERSION is untouched.

The choice per item is recorded in
docs/decisions/3216-wire-overlap-rework.md: items 2 and 3 are defects
of what the feature claims, so they are implemented properly; items 4
and 5 are refused by name at the command door, safer than a
half-implemented overlap on the burnout, 4-axis and taper builders.

Main moved while the rework ran (the wire exit pick, the arc joins, the rotary stated axis, the tool preview), so the branch carries one more merge of current main, resolved keeping both sides, and the gates below ran on the refreshed head.

Gates on the resolved tree: motion lib 668 passed, sim lib 253 passed, app lib 311 passed, ui lib 1659 passed; mcp_wire_contour 8, wire_verify 3, golden_cl 34, wire_post 13, wire_stamp 8, wire_contour 19, wire_burnout 4, wire_taper 11, wire_4axis 8, wire_verify_tol 4,
conformance 7 (every builtin posts every golden byte exact), the
sodick wire suites, g_edm_post, agie_native; clippy app + motion + sim
+ ui --all-targets -D warnings clean. example_catalog's
2d/drill-overfeed refusal.txt CRLF red is the known environmental
#3628, unrelated to this diff (41 of its steps pass).

Changelog: Wire Contour: a stated closing overlap rides the cut past its seam; a centre-line slit side for open runs; skim passes on open runs re-entered from the air.

Process change: yes

Fixes #3216

title: feat(post): add Hurco WinMax (NC) ISNC post and Hurco VM10i machine
body:
Replaces #2640 with the same Hurco commit (`4cd8bdae2`, cherry-picked unchanged) on a branch straight off `main`. #2640 was stacked on the Grbl post draft #2506, so it could not merge before #2506; this one does not need it.

## Latest review fixes

Head: `ed04216dc468f9880dea0651c813b5762c401488`.

- Finding 1: Cancel active cycles before travel. Seat each hole at the section hop before descent to R. Refuse missing hops.
- The `cycle_hop` suite includes Hurco. It checks back-to-back cycles and cycles after probing, feeds, and arcs.
- Finding 3: Set the vendor to `Camcraft`. `hurco_post_vendor_is_camcraft` pins the value.
- All 30 focused tests passed. Cycle seating, feed tracking, arc tracking, and vendor mutations failed their pins. Restored fixes passed.
- Update the synthesized Hurco golden for safe hops. Conformance passed all 7 tests.
- Clippy for `camcraft-post` and `camcraft-app`, all targets with warnings denied: passed.
- Quick gate ran 648 steps. After the golden update, only `continuous_4axis_part` remains red: `/version: 71 != 70`.
- Finding 2 remains open. No simulator access, load results, or path comparisons are available. Issue #2573 remains incomplete.

Re-checked on this branch: `camcraft-post --test script_hurco_winmax` 11 passed; `camcraft-app --test hurco_winmax_post` 7, `post_spindle_rule_all` 2, `conformance` 5 passed.

---

## What changed

- Add clean-room built-in post `Hurco WinMax (NC)` in `assets/posts/hurco-winmax.cps`.
- Add clean-room 3-axis VMC definition `Hurco VM10i` in `assets/machines/hurco-vm10i.mch`.
- Register both entries in `BUILTINS`, `MACHINES`, and `embedded()` inside `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs`.
- Emit Hurco WinMax ISNC blocks (`G20`/`G21` unit block, `O0001`..`O9999`, `G90 G17 G94 G54..G59 G40 G49 G80`, `G54.1 P1`..`P93`, decimal-second `P` dwell on `G04`/`G82`/`G89`, `G84.2`/`G84.3` rigid tapping and `G84` floating tapping, `G68`/`G69` rotation, `G31` probing with `G10 L2`, no `G91.1`).
- Record design decisions in `docs/decisions/2573-hurco-winmax-post.md`.

## Cause

No built-in post processor or machine definition existed for Hurco WinMax 3-axis NC/ISO (ISNC) mills.

## Tests

- Pins:
  - `crates/post/tests/hurco_winmax_post.rs` (8/8 pass; red before fix `0/7`: `hurco-winmax.cps` missing): multi-op contour/arc/drill/peck/tap across two tools and two offsets, `G20`/`G21` and `EndUnits`, decimal-second `P` dwell, `G84.2`/`G84.3`/`G84`, `G54`..`G59` and `G54.1 P1`..`P93`, `G28`/`G53` safe retract, `O0001`..`O9999` bounds, `G41`/`G42` compensation, `G68`/`G69` rotation, `G31` probing, smoothing note, named refusals, and a strict documented WinMax ISNC word-set allowlist check over posted programs and all 21 `.nc` goldens.
  - `crates/app/tests/hurco_winmax_post.rs` (2/2 pass; red before fix `0/2`: missing registry entries): checks `BUILTINS`/`MACHINES` registration, `post_serves`, VM10i parse, full ECS contour/pocket/drill/peck/rigid-tap workflow across two tools and `G54`/`G55`, plus `G54.1 P1`.
  - Cross-post suites updated and green: `conformance` (7/7), `machine` (33/33), `machine_library` (11/11), `post_spindle_rule_all` (5/5), `bore_cycle` (9/9), `comp_plane` (3/3), `decimal_point_fanuc_family` (3/3), `declared_options` (3/3), `end_units` (3/3), `first_traverse_clearance_fanuc_family` (9/9), `radius_arcs` (7/7), `script_hurco_winmax` (11/11).
- Mutations (each verified RED when reverted/weakened, GREEN when restored):
  - `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` reverted to `HEAD`: `0/1` (`hurco_winmax_post_and_vm10i_are_registered_and_serve_mill` fails), restored `1/1`.
  - `oWord()` `1..=9999` check removed: `0/1` (`extended_work_offsets_and_safe_retract_and_o_word` fails), restored `1/1`.
  - `workOffsetMax` raised and `> 99` guard removed: `0/1` (`extended_work_offsets_and_safe_retract_and_o_word` fails), restored `1/1`.
  - `G53` missing `safeRetractZ` check removed: `0/1` (`extended_work_offsets_and_safe_retract_and_o_word` fails), restored `1/1`.
  - `rigidTapping === false` check removed: `0/1` (`tapping_modes_and_rigid_tapping_guard` fails), restored `1/1`.
  - Cycle illegal dwell `rawDwell > 0` check removed: `0/1` (`cycles_refuse_illegal_dwell_and_tilt_and_zero_spindle` fails), restored `1/1`.
  - `tiltOk()` 3-axis guard bypassed: `0/1` (`cycles_refuse_illegal_dwell_and_tilt_and_zero_spindle` fails), restored `1/1`.
- Gate & lint:
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 643 step(s), 0 failed (57.0 min).
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: 0 warnings, exit 0.

## Goldens moved

- Added 14 new `conformance` goldens under `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/hurco-winmax/*.nc` (13 ops) and `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/synth_hurco-winmax.nc`.
- Added 11 new `script_hurco_winmax` recorded goldens under `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/hurco-winmax/` (7 `.nc`, 4 `.refusal`).
- No existing `.nc` or `.cl` goldens changed.

## Not exercised

Latest review finding 2 remains open. The required simulator load results and path comparisons are not available. Issue #2573 remains incomplete.

Programs were not verified on the community owner's WinMax `09.01.393.30` simulator or on a physical Hurco control. Behaviour follows published Hurco WinMax Mill NC documentation (`704-0116-101`, `support.hurco.com`) and public Hurco VM10i specifications.

## Overlaps

This PR branches from `main`. It touches these functions and tables:
- `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` (`BUILTINS`, `MACHINES`, `embedded`)
- `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs` (`POSTS`, `EXTENSIONS`)
- `crates/app/tests/machine.rs` (`every_shipped_machine_mounts_and_speaks_its_declaration`)
- `crates/app/tests/post_spindle_rule_all.rs` (`POSTS`)
- `crates/post/tests/bore_cycle.rs` (`NO_DWELL`)
- `crates/post/tests/comp_plane.rs` (`POSTS`)
- `crates/post/tests/decimal_point_fanuc_family.rs` (`MILL_POSTS`)
- `crates/post/tests/declared_options.rs` (`shipped_milling_posts_declare_valid_option_schemas`)
- `crates/post/tests/end_units.rs` (`writing_mill_posts_emit_end_unit_word_before_program_end`)
- `crates/post/tests/first_traverse_clearance_fanuc_family.rs` (`POSTS`)
- `crates/post/tests/radius_arcs.rs` (`RADIUS_POSTS`)

Open PRs `#2515` and `#2310` also touch `posting_files.rs` / `conformance.rs` / `machine.rs` and were already conflicting with `main` at Step 2.

Refs #2573
